message.content:
Based on my search, "CFA Ins" most likely refers to **CFA Institute**, the global organization that administers the Chartered Financial Analyst (CFA) program. Here's a comprehensive overview:

## What is CFA Institute?

**CFA Institute** is a global association of investment professionals that offers the **CFA charter**—one of the most respected credentials in finance. It was founded in 1947 and is headquartered in Charlottesville, Virginia, USA.

## CFA Program Overview

The CFA program consists of **three levels of exams** covering:
- Investment tools
- Asset valuation
- Portfolio management
- Wealth planning
- Ethics and professional standards

## 2026 CFA Exam Fees

Starting February 2026, CFA Institute **abolished the one-time $350 enrollment fee**. Current fees are:

| Component | Early Registration | Standard Registration |
|-----------|-------------------|----------------------|
| Level I & II | $1,140 | $1,490 |
| Level III | $1,240 | $1,590 |

**Total minimum cost (all 3 levels, early registration):** ~$3,520-$3,570

## Membership Requirements

To earn the CFA charter, you must:
1. **Pass all 3 exam levels**
2. **Complete 4,000 hours** of qualified work experience over at least 36 months (investment decision-making related)
3. **Provide 2-3 professional references** (2 if one is an active regular member of a local CFA society; 3 otherwise)
4. **Apply for regular membership** with CFA Institute and a local society
5. **Sign the Ethics pledge**

## Annual Membership Dues

| Type | Cost |
|------|------|
| CFA Institute Global Dues | **$299/year** (regular members) |
| CFA Society India (example) | INR 5,000 + 18% GST (~$60) |
| Professional Leave status | $100 (CFA Institute) + INR 2,000 + GST (local) |

**Important:** You must maintain active membership to use the CFA designation. If membership lapses, you lose the right to use "CFA" after your name.

## Local CFA Societies

CFA Institute has **over 160 local societies** worldwide (e.g., CFA Society India, CFA Society New York). Joining a local society is **required** for charterholder membership and provides:
- Networking events
- Career resources
- Continuing education
- Regional professional community

## Key Resources

- Official website: https://www.cfainstitute.org
- Membership application: https://www.cfainstitute.org/en/membership/join
- Local society directory: Available through CFA Institute

---

Sources:
1. https://300hours.com/cfa-exam-cost/
2. https://capstonelearnings.com/cfa-vs-frm-india/
3. https://www.zelleducation.com/blog/cfa-membership-fees/
4. https://cfasocietyindia.org/membership/
5. https://quintedge.com/blog/cfa-course-fee
6. https://300hours.com/cfa-requirements/
